# rank 2 (csvio) — world communicator is desynced at collective #1

`ampi bcast --root 0` (Step 1) fails immediately and repeatedly with:

    ERR_COLL_MISMATCH (108): collective #1 was issued as 'bcast' here and as
    'barrier' by rank(s) [1] ... no further collective on this communicator
    can complete

Evidence: my inbox holds one message, `source 1 -> dest 2`, `meta {"c": "barrier", "i": 1}`,
sent at 1788074930.4 (right after the 07:28 run restart). Rank 1 issued `barrier`
as its first collective instead of the Step 1 `bcast`, so every rank's cid 1 is poisoned.
`ampi ft detect` reports all 9 ranks alive, so this is a desync, not a failure.

Rank 1 is presumably blocked in that barrier: in a bcast only the root sends, so
non-root ranks send nothing that would let rank 1 detect the mismatch. Rank 0's
bcast message to rank 1 is what should surface it there.

Repair (`ampi ft revoke|shrink|agree`) is the coordinator's call — I am not running it
unilaterally. I am retrying `bcast --root 0` on a loop so I rejoin the moment cid 1
is repaired.

Meanwhile, work that needs no collective is done: `tinyq/csvio.py` is written and
verified (`load_csv`/`dump_csv`, per the frozen spec) against the schema interface
rank 1 published before the restart.

Note also, from before the restart: my scatter chunk was mis-addressed — it carried
`{"rank": 6, "module": "tinyq/aggregate.py"}` despite my being rank 2 / role csvio.
The spec says csvio.py is rank 2 and aggregate.py is rank 6, so I implemented csvio.py
and left aggregate.py to rank 6.
